description: An on/off switch that submits like a checkbox and is announced as a switch. Three sizes, an optional tick and cross, before or after its text, or as a card. Works with Livewire wire:model.

consider.note: It submits like a checkbox: switched off, it sends nothing. Read it with `$request->boolean()`, or give it `unchecked-value="0"`, and validate it with `boolean`.
A switch that changes who can see or do something (a public profile, an admin flag) needs a policy check as well as validation, and shouldn't be fillable from any other form.
